title: AutoScreenShot
description: Make a screenshots if u push a command like a kick,ban,mute,freeze
body:
Enhance your Minecraft moderation experience with the Screenshot Organizer Mod! This powerful tool automatically captures and organizes screenshots when you use important moderation commands, ensuring you have a visual record of every action.

**Key Features**:

Automatic Screenshots: Captures images when you use /mute, /ban, /freeze, or /kick commands.

Server-Specific Organization: Automatically sorts screenshots into folders named after the server's IP address.

High-Quality PNG Format: All screenshots are saved in crystal-clear PNG format for the best image quality.

Timestamped Filenames: Each screenshot is named with the exact date and time it was taken.

Whether you're a server admin, moderator, or just want to keep track of your actions, the Screenshot Organizer Mod is your perfect companion. Never lose an important moment again!

Note: This mod is designed for Forge and requires the Forge mod loader to function.
